name: Sumisaujana Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，Sumisaujana Group Berhad 通过子公司 SSTCM 与 TOPSOE A/S 签署谅解备忘录，并持续更新与 PT Kilang Pertamina Internasional、SPCI Helm Malaysia 及 TOPSOE 的多方谅解备忘录，以及与 Zhangjiagang CoolisT Life Technology 的谅解备忘录状态，相关备忘录均无重大进展。公司未公告新的产能扩张、业务出售或合约订单。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增长22.3%，净利润同比增长252.3%。
overview_en: In 2026, Sumisaujana Group Berhad, through its subsidiary SSTCM, entered into a memorandum of understanding with TOPSOE A/S, and continued to update the status of the multi-party MOU with PT Kilang Pertamina Internasional, SPCI Helm Malaysia and TOPSOE, as well as the MOU with Zhangjiagang CoolisT Life Technology; no material development was reported for these MOUs. The company did not announce any new capacity expansion, business disposal or contract orders.
